title: Gammer Grizzle's Cupboard Cure-All
tagline: Brewed from the bathroom shelf and the bottom of the shed.

ingredients.item: flannel, wrung out by a grumpy goblin
imaginary toenail clippings, made of glitter

steps:
Wring the flannel till it squeaks and groans,
Then drop it in with cackles and moans.

Add eyebrows three, all felty and fluffed,
Then stir with a rake till the whole lot's puffed.

Fling in the fluff from the shed's dark nook,
And the gloves, to give it a handshake look.

Sprinkle the glitter-clippings, snip-snap-snow,
Then plop in the bogey gloop, nice and slow.

Pop in the spout and let it toot and blow,
Then stir by the light of a cabbage-green glow.
image_prompt: A huge black iron cauldron overflowing with lurid green gloop, a damp grey flannel draped over the rim, felt eyebrows floating on top, tangled cobweb fluff, two empty gardening gloves poking out like waving hands, glittery silver clippings and a rusty watering-can spout sticking out of the slime.
alt_text: A bubbling cauldron of bright green gloop with a flannel, felt eyebrows, cobwebs, garden gloves and a rusty spout poking out.
caption_hook:
Gammer Grizzle has raided the bathroom cupboard and the shed again. Roald Dahl would have asked for seconds of the rhyme, not the brew.

Which ingredient would you hide from her first?
rhyme:
Into the cauldron, a flannel, soggy and grey,
Wrung by a goblin who's had a bad day!
Three felty eyebrows, all wobbly and bent,
Plus cobweb fluff from the shed, dust-scented.
Garden gloves waving, so floppy and green,
Glittery toenails, the grandest I've seen!
Bogey-green gloop in four dollops, plip-plop,
A whistling spout, then I stir till I drop!
Pinch of powdered grumble, a cackle, a cough,
Gammer's Cure-All! Now stand well off!
